items.title: Unramified and tamely ramified separable extensions stay so after tensoring with an extension of discrete valuation rings
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter more-algebra.tex (More on Algebra)

items.difficulty_reason: The lemma takes an extension A in B of discrete valuation rings with fraction field extension L/K and a finite separable extension K'/K, notes that K' tensor_K L is a finite product of fields, and asserts that if K' is unramified with respect to A then each factor is unramified with respect to B, and that if K' is tamely ramified with respect to A then each factor is tamely ramified with respect to B (source lines 34329-34345). The proof handles the two cases separately. Case (1) is short but real: the ring map A -> A' to the integral closure is finite etale, so B' = B tensor_A A' is finite etale over B and a finite product of Dedekind domains, hence is the integral closure of B in K' tensor_K L, and the conclusion follows (proof lines 34353-34359). Case (2) requires a reduction: one may replace K' by a larger extension already tame over A, and then the characterisation of tame extensions lets one assume K' contains K[pi^{1/e}] for some e invertible in kappa_A with K' unramified over A[pi^{1/e}] (proof lines 34362-34367). The proof then decomposes K[pi^{1/e}] tensor_K L into factors L_{e,j}, notes each L'_i is a finite separable extension of some L_{e,j_i}, and applies case (1) to conclude unramifiedness of L'_i over the localizations (B_{e,j_i})_m; this reduces the problem to showing that each L_{e,j} is tamely ramified over B (proof lines 34368-34381). The last computation is explicit and is where the tame hypothesis is consumed: writing the uniformizer of B and the e-th root relation, the proof exhibits A[pi^{1/e}] tensor_A B as a subring of B[y, z]/(y^{e'} - theta, z^e - u) with e' = e/gcd(e, t), which is a product of Dedekind domains each tamely ramified over B (proof lines 34384-34394). The non-routine content is the reduction step and the final explicit subring computation with the gcd exponent.
